title: StoredVersions
description: The saved form of a stored-versions check: for each spec the check named, the version a `latest: "stored"` read of it would serve from its stored head, or null when that read would not serve from the head. `to_json()` (`toJSON()` in TypeScript) writes it and `StoredVersions.from_json` (`StoredVersions.fromJSON`) reads it back, so a page built in one language checks freshness in another. A writer lists the heads sorted by `spec_id` by code point, each spec once.

content_version.description: The dataset version the stored head names, or null when a stored read would not serve from the head: no head, a head whose import was replaced, a head past the serve-stale ceiling, a revoked version, or a spec DFO has not registered.
